title: Alexandria, VA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Alexandria, VA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Alexandria is a city in VA with a population of 160,000. Historic DC suburb with Old Town’s cobblestone streets and the King Street Mile. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
